sharpe.label: Sharpe ratio
sharpe.short: Rendement earned pour each unit de risque taken.
sharpe.body: Pour every unit de cours swing ce investissement put vous through, it returned ce many units de rendement above liquidités. It treats upside et downside swings as equally bad, which est why we afficher Sortino suivant à it.
sharpe.scale: Above 1.0 est generally considered good, above 2.0 excellent.
sharpe.caveat: Sharpe ratios estimated au-dessus a few years carry a lot de uncertainty — le période shown après le ± est le 95% confidence interval. If two investissements' ranges overlap heavily, le difference between them est probably noise.

sortino.label: Sortino ratio
sortino.short: Rendement earned pour each unit de downside risque taken.
sortino.body: Like Sharpe, but only counts downward swings as risque. Upside surprises don't nombre against it. Usually higher than Sharpe; a Sortino much higher than le Sharpe means most de ce investment's volatility était à le upside.
sortino.scale: Above 1.0 est generally considered good, above 2.0 excellent.

calmar.label: Calmar ratio
calmar.short: Annual rendement per unit de worst drawdown.
calmar.body: How much annual rendement vous got pour le worst peak-à-trough fall vous would have lived through. Le most intuitive risque-adjusted ratio: rendement per unit de worst pain.
calmar.scale: Above 0.5 est decent, above 1.0 est strong.

martin.label: Martin ratio (UPI)
martin.short: Annual rendement per unit de le Ulcer Index.
martin.body: Like Calmar, but uses le whole drawdown path — how deep et how long — rather than just le single worst point. A plus complete picture de how uncomfortable le ride était.
martin.scale: Higher est better; compare it only against other instruments au-dessus le same période.

volatility.label: Volatilité
volatility.short: How much le cours swings, annualised.
volatility.body: Le annualised standard deviation de quotidien returns. Shown pour reference, but deliberately pas le headline risque figure here — research shows investors feel drawdowns, pas jour-à-jour wiggle, so we lead avec max drawdown instead.

maxDrawdown.label: Baisse maximale
maxDrawdown.short: Le worst peak-à-trough fall au-dessus ce période.
maxDrawdown.body: If vous had bought at le worst possible moment, ce est how far down vous would have been avant it recovered — le single number cela best predicts whether a real investor would have panic-sold.

timeUnderWater.label: Temps en dessous water
timeUnderWater.short: How long it took à get back à even.
timeUnderWater.body: Le span de le prior peak à full recovery. Ce est le number cela actually determines whether a retail investor capitulates — pas le depth de le fall, but how long they'd have had à wait it out.

ulcerIndex.label: Ulcer Index
ulcerIndex.short: A single number pour how deep et how long le drawdowns étaient.
ulcerIndex.body: Squares each day's drawdown depth avant averaging, so it penalises deep, prolonged declines far plus than brief dips — closer à how a loss actually feels than plain volatility.

var95.label: Valeur at Risque (95%)
var95.short: Le threshold pour a bad-but-pas-worst jour.
var95.body: Sur le worst 1 jour dans 20 au-dessus ce période, le loss était at least ce large. It says nothing about how much worse le remaining 5% de days pourrait get — see CVaR pour cela.

cvar95.label: Expected shortfall (95%)
cvar95.short: Le moyenne loss sur le worst days.
cvar95.body: Le moyenne loss across only le worst 5% de days — answers "et when it est cela bad, how bad sur moyenne?". Strictly plus informative than VaR alone.

beta.label: Bêta
beta.short: How much ce moves pour each 1% move dans le benchmark.
beta.body: A beta de 1.2 means it typically moved 1.2% when le benchmark moved 1%.
beta.caveat: Always check le R² suivant à it: if R² est bas, le benchmark explains very little de ce instrument's movement et le beta isn't telling vous much.

alpha.label: Alpha (annualised)
alpha.short: Rendement restant au-dessus après accounting pour marché exposure.
alpha.body: Le annualised rendement ce instrument produced beyond what its beta à le benchmark would predict.
alpha.caveat: A single-factor alpha against one benchmark est pas strong evidence de skill — check its own confidence interval et R² avant reading much into it.

rSquared.label: R²
rSquared.short: How much de le movement le benchmark actually explains.
rSquared.body: Le share de ce instrument's variance explained par le benchmark dans le beta/alpha regression. Professionals always check ce suivant à beta — a beta de a regression avec bas R² est mostly noise.

upCapture.label: Up capture
upCapture.short: How much de le benchmark's up days ce captured.
upCapture.body: Sur days le benchmark rose, ce instrument captured ce percentage de cela move sur moyenne.

downCapture.label: Down capture
downCapture.short: How much de le benchmark's down days ce captured.
downCapture.body: Sur days le benchmark fell, ce instrument captured ce percentage de cela fall sur moyenne. Lower est better here — it means smaller losses sur le benchmark's bad days.

informationRatio.label: Information ratio
informationRatio.short: Actif rendement per unit de tracking erreur versus le benchmark.
informationRatio.body: Le right way à answer "était ce better than le index, et how consistently?" — actif rendement divided par how much cela rendement varied.

trackingError.label: Tracking erreur
trackingError.short: How much ce instrument's rendement diverges de le benchmark's.
trackingError.body: Le annualised volatility de le rendement difference between ce instrument et le benchmark. A near-index fonds has a tracking erreur fermer à zero.

correlation.label: Correlation
correlation.short: How closely two instruments move together.
correlation.body: De −1 à +1. Above about 0.8 means position both gives vous much less diversification than it looks like — they will usually move together.
correlation.scale: Below 0.3 est meaningfully diversifying; above 0.8 est fermer à redundant.

downsideCorrelation.label: Downside correlation
downsideCorrelation.short: Corrélation measured only sur le benchmark's worst days.
downsideCorrelation.body: Diversification matters most exactly when things go wrong, et correlations usually rise dans a crash.
downsideCorrelation.caveat: If ce number est much higher than le headline correlation, these two won't protect vous when it counts.

diversificationRatio.label: Diversification ratio
diversificationRatio.short: How much combining these actually reduced risque.
diversificationRatio.body: Le weighted moyenne de each instrument's own volatility, divided par le volatility de position them together dans equal poids. A ratio well above 1.0 means real diversification benefit; near 1.0 means position them together barely helped.

cagr.label: CAGR
cagr.short: Compound annual croissance rate au-dessus ce période.
cagr.body: Le constant annual croissance rate cela would take le starting cours à le ending cours au-dessus ce exact span, sur a calendar-jour basis so periods de different lengths sont comparable.

cumulativeReturn.label: Rendement cumulé
cumulativeReturn.short: Total rendement au-dessus le whole période, uncompounded à a annuel rate.
cumulativeReturn.body: How much a single investissement made ou lost de le début de le période à le fin, including dividends.

trailingPe.label: Trailing P/E
trailingPe.short: Cours divided par le dernier 12 months de earnings.
trailingPe.body: How many years de actuel earnings you're paying pour at today's cours. Always read against a peer ou secteur reference — a P/E de 28 means nothing sur its own.
trailingPe.caveat: Undefined ou misleading when earnings sont négatif ou unusually depressed/inflated.

forwardPe.label: Ratio cours/bénéfice prévisionnel
forwardPe.short: Cours divided par suivant year's expected earnings.
forwardPe.body: Like trailing P/E, but based sur analyst estimates rather than reported résultats — plus forward-looking, but only as reliable as le estimates behind it.
forwardPe.caveat: Depends sur analyst consensus estimates, which can be wrong ou sparse pour smaller names.

priceToBook.label: Cours à book
priceToBook.short: Cours relative à accounting net actif valeur.
priceToBook.body: How le marché values le entreprise relative à what its solde sheet says it's worth.
priceToBook.caveat: Fermer à meaningless pour actif-light software businesses; pour financials it est often le primary valuation metric.

evToEbitda.label: EV / EBITDA
evToEbitda.short: Enterprise valeur relative à operating earnings.
evToEbitda.body: Capital-structure-neutre, so it compares companies fairly regardless de how much dette they carry — le multiple professionals actually use pour cross-entreprise comparison.

evToSales.label: EV / Sales
evToSales.body: Le fallback valuation multiple when earnings sont négatif — which est exactly when P/E goes blank.

dividendYield.label: Rendement du dividende
dividendYield.short: Annual dividends as a percentage de cours.
dividendYield.body: How much liquidités revenu le actuel cours buys vous per année, avant any cours change.
dividendYield.caveat: A haut rendement alone can be a warning sign (a "rendement trap") — always check le payout ratio suivant à it à see whether le dividend est sustainable.

payoutRatio.label: Payout ratio
payoutRatio.short: Le share de earnings paid out as dividends.
payoutRatio.body: What fraction de profit goes à dividends rather than being reinvested ou retained. A ratio near ou above 100% leaves little cushion if earnings dip.

fcfYield.label: Free liquidités flow rendement
fcfYield.short: Free liquidités flow as a percentage de marché valeur.
fcfYield.body: Free liquidités flow est harder à manipulate avec accounting choices than reported earnings, et it's defined even when P/E est pas (négatif earnings).

roe.label: Rendement sur equity
roe.short: Profit generated per unit de shareholder equity.
roe.body: A quality measure: how efficiently le entreprise turns shareholders' capital into profit.
roe.caveat: Leverage inflates ROE mechanically — always check dette/equity alongside it.

debtToEquity.label: Dette / equity
debtToEquity.short: Total dette relative à shareholder equity.
debtToEquity.body: A core solvency measure — haut leverage est le single best predictor de permanent capital loss dans a downturn.

expenseRatio.label: Ratio de frais
expenseRatio.short: Le fund's annual fee, taken automatically de its valeur.
expenseRatio.body: Le most reliable predictor de how a fonds performs against its peers — dans any marché, net returns equal gross returns minus costs, so le bas-cost fonds tends à win par arithmetic.
expenseRatio.caveat: A 1%/année difference compounds à roughly a quarter de terminal wealth au-dessus 30 years.

psr.label: Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio
psr.short: Le probability le true Sharpe ratio est genuinely above zero.
psr.body: Converts a point estimate into a confidence statement, accounting pour sample size, skew et fat tails — le honest version de "est ce actually good, ou did it just get lucky?"
psr.caveat: A statement about le past, calculated de le sample shown — pas a forecast.

honesty.title: Read ce avant vous trust le numbers above

hindsight.title: Hindsight
hindsight.body: Vous chose these dates knowing what happened. Ce shows what did happen dans ce window, pas what will happen suivant.

survivorship.title: Survivorship bias
survivorship.body: Vous can only backtest instruments cela still exist et sont still listed. Companies cela went à zero sont pas dans ce dataset. Recherche sur le US marché (Bessembinder, 2018) found le median listed action underperformed Treasury bills au-dessus its lifetime — le winners vous can still see sont le survivors.

costs.title: Cost realism
costs.body: Ce assumes 0.10% per transaction et fractional shares. It excludes taxes, currency conversion spreads, bid–ask spreads, et platform compte fees.

data.title: Données basis
data.body: Cours sont Yahoo Finance quotidien adjusted closes, which assume dividends sont reinvested at le closing cours sur le ex-dividend date.

deflated.title: Adjusted pour how many tries ce took

twr.label: Temps-weighted rendement
twr.short: How le investissement performed, ignoring when vous added money.
twr.body: Temps-weighted rendement measures how le investissement performed, ignoring when vous added money. It est what a fonds rapports.

mwr.label: Money-weighted rendement
mwr.short: How vous performed, including le timing de votre contributions.
mwr.body: Money-weighted rendement (IRR) measures how vous performed, including le timing de votre contributions. If it est lower than le temps-weighted rendement, votre money arrived at less fortunate moments — which est normal et mostly luck.

deflatedSharpe.label: Deflated Sharpe ratio
deflatedSharpe.short: Sharpe, adjusted pour how many scenarios vous have tried.
deflatedSharpe.body: When vous essayez many strategies, le best-looking one est partly lucky. Ce adjusts le score pour how many scenarios vous have run, so a good-looking résultat has à be genuinely good rather than le best de many tries.

entrySensitivity.label: Entry-date sensitivity
entrySensitivity.short: How much le résultat depends sur le exact jour vous started.
entrySensitivity.body: Le same investissement started a few weeks earlier ou later. A wide spread means le résultat depends heavily sur le exact jour vous picked — which vous chose knowing what happened suivant.

costDrag.label: Cost drag
costDrag.body: Trading fees, compounded. Small percentages become large amounts au-dessus long periods — ce est le single most reliable way à improve returns, because unlike returns, costs sont certain.

regime.weightRanging: Overbought/oversold signaux have historically been plus meaningful than trend signaux dans ce sideways environment.

signals.title: What le indicators sont saying together
signals.footer: Professional analysts look pour agreement across several indicators. Disagreement est information too — it usually means aucun effacer signal.

priceVsSma200.above: Cours est above its 200-jour moving moyenne, a conventional (if crude) long-term uptrend marker.
priceVsSma200.below: Cours est below its 200-jour moving moyenne, a conventional (if crude) long-term downtrend marker.
priceVsSma200.neutral: Cours est within 1% de its 200-jour moving moyenne — too fermer à call a effacer trend de ce alone.

smaCross.golden: Le 50-jour moyenne est above le 200-jour moyenne (a “golden cross” regime) — a conventional bullish trend marker.
smaCross.death: Le 50-jour moyenne est below le 200-jour moyenne (a “death cross” regime) — a conventional bearish trend marker.
smaCross.neutral: Le 50- et 200-jour averages sont too fermer à call a effacer regime.

rsi.trending_overbought: RSI est {{rsi}}, above le conventional 70 “overbought” line. But ADX est {{adx}}, which says ce instrument est dans a strong trend — et dans strong trends RSI routinely stays above 70 pour weeks ou months. Dans ce context an elevated RSI est much weaker evidence than it would be dans a sideways marché.
rsi.ranging_overbought: RSI est {{rsi}} et ADX est {{adx}}, meaning cours has been moving sideways rather than trending. Overbought readings have historically been plus meaningful dans période-bound conditions than dans trending ones — but ‘plus meaningful’ est pas le same as reliable.
rsi.trending_oversold: RSI est {{rsi}}, below le conventional 30 “oversold” line, while ADX ({{adx}}) shows a strong trend dans place — dans a strong downtrend RSI can stay depressed pour a long temps.
rsi.ranging_oversold: RSI est {{rsi}} et ADX est {{adx}} (période-bound). Oversold readings have historically carried a little plus poids dans sideways conditions.
rsi.random_walk: Statistically, ce instrument's récent cours movements sont indistinguishable de a random walk (variance-ratio test, p={{p}}). Trend-following indicators assume le opposite. Treat what follows as description, pas prediction.
rsi.neutral: RSI est {{rsi}}, within le conventional 30–70 neutre band.

macd.bullish: Le MACD histogram est positif et rising — short-term momentum has turned upward relative à le longer term. Ce est a lagging measure par construction.
macd.bearish: Le MACD histogram est négatif et falling — short-term momentum has turned downward relative à le longer term. Ce est a lagging measure par construction.
macd.neutral: Le MACD histogram est fermer à zero — aucun effacer momentum shift either way right now.

bollinger.above: Cours est above le upper Bollinger Band (%B > 1). Cours spends about 95% de its temps inside le bands, so ce est uncommon but pas exceptional sur its own.
bollinger.below: Cours est below le lower Bollinger Band (%B < 0).
bollinger.inside: Cours est within le Bollinger Bands (0 ≤ %B ≤ 1), where it spends most de its temps.

obv.divergence_bearish: Cours has been making nouveau highs while sur-solde volume has pas — le move looks like it est happening sur thinner participation than le dernier one.
obv.divergence_bullish: Cours has been making nouveau lows while sur-solde volume has pas fallen avec it — selling pressure looks like it may be thinning.
obv.confirming: Sur-solde volume est moving dans le same direction as cours, avec aucun divergence detected au-dessus le trailing window.
obv.unavailable: Volume données isn't disponible pour ce instrument, so OBV can't be computed.

adx.context: ADX measures trend strength, pas direction. At {{adx}} ce instrument est {{state}} — use it à weigh how much à trust le trend-following indicators above.

signals.lowConfidenceNote: Lower confidence: short historique, an insignificant random-walk test, ou thin volume weakens ce reading.

monteCarlo.title: Possible paths de here

modelHints.bootstrap: Resamples blocks de ce instrument's own historical quotidien moves, which preserves real patterns de calm et turbulent stretches.
modelHints.gbm: Le textbook random-walk model: returns drawn de a normal distribution. Its tails sont visibly thinner than what markets actually produce.
modelHints.student_t: A normal-shaped model avec fatter tails than le plain bell curve, closer à how markets actually behave but still pas a resampling de real historique.

monteCarlo.sentenceIntro: Based sur how {{symbol}} has actually behaved au-dessus le past {{years}} years, dans {{horizon}} trading days:
monteCarlo.bulletMiddleHalf: le middle half de simulated outcomes land between {{low}} et {{high}}
monteCarlo.bulletAboveToday: {{pct}} de paths finish above today's cours
monteCarlo.bulletDrawdown20: dans {{pct}} de paths, le cours fell plus than 20% at some point along le way
monteCarlo.calibrationNote: Ce est pas a forecast. It resamples {{symbol}}'s actual quotidien moves de {{start}} à {{end}} dans blocks, which preserves its real pattern de calm et turbulent stretches. It assumes {{driftNote}}. It ne peut pas know about anything cela has pas happened avant — an earnings surprise, a takeover, a marché crash de a nouveau kind.
monteCarlo.calibrationVolNote: Actuel volatility est dans le {{percentile}}th percentile de le dernier three years, so if conditions rendement à normal, le real période would be wider than shown.
monteCarlo.driftNoteZero: aucun expected drift, so it says nothing about direction
monteCarlo.driftNoteHistorical: a historical drift de {{drift}}/yr (±{{se}} standard erreur — treat le direction avec real skepticism)
monteCarlo.driftNoteRiskFree: drift at le risque-free rate, le risque-neutre convention

rsi.label: RSI
rsi.body: A 0–100 momentum gauge comparing récent gains à récent losses. Above 70 est conventionally called 'overbought', below 30 'oversold'. These sont conventions, pas laws — dans a strong trend RSI can sit above 70 pour months while le cours keeps rising. Read it alongside le trend strength shown above.

macd.label: MACD
macd.body: Le gap between a fast et a slow moving moyenne. When le bars flip de below à above zero, short-term momentum has turned upward relative à le longer term. It est a lagging measure par construction — it describes what has already changed.

bollinger.label: Bollinger Bands
bollinger.body: A moving moyenne avec bands two standard deviations above et below. Cours spends about 95% de its temps inside le bands, so touching a band est common, pas exceptional. When le bands squeeze tight, le instrument has been unusually calm — et calm periods have historically been plus often followed par large moves, dans either direction.

atr.label: ATR
atr.body: Le typical size de a day's cours période, dans currency. An ATR de 4.20 means a 4 move sur a given jour est ordinary, pas actualités. Traders use it à size stop-losses; long-term investors can use it à calibrate what 'normal' looks like.

obv.label: OBV
obv.body: Adds le day's volume when cours closes up et subtracts it when cours closes down. If cours est making nouveau highs while ce line est pas, le move est happening sur thinner trading than le précédent one.

adx.label: ADX
adx.body: Measures how strongly cours est trending, sans saying dans which direction. Below 20 means sideways; above 25 means a real trend est dans place. It est le context cela decides how much poids à give le other indicators.

varianceRatio.label: Variance ratio test
varianceRatio.body: A statistical test de whether cours movements have any memory. If le résultat est pas significant, ce instrument's récent movements sont indistinguishable de coin flips — which est what most academic finance predicts, et it means trend indicators have little à work avec here.

monteCarlo.label: Monte Carlo simulation
monteCarlo.body: Thousands de simulated futures built par reshuffling ce instrument's own historical quotidien moves. It shows le période de what its past behaviour makes plausible — pas a prediction. Le width de le fan est le message.

supportResistance.label: Support & resistance
supportResistance.body: Cours areas where ce instrument has repeatedly stopped et turned around. They matter because other marché participants watch them et place orders around them, which can make them partly self-fulfilling. They sont pas floors ou ceilings — they break regularly.

states.insufficientHistory: Needs at least 200 days de historique — ce instrument has {{bars}}.
states.noVolume: Volume données isn't disponible pour ce instrument, so sur-solde volume isn't shown.
states.crypto: Crypto trades 24/7, so quotidien-bar indicators here behave a little differently than pour actions.

footer.priceBasis: Le cours chart, moving averages et levels use unadjusted cours — le cours cela actually traded — while volatility et le simulation use dividend-adjusted total-rendement cours.
